primary_use_cases: Production long-term memory for AI agents and chatbots; multi-session personalization; framework-integrated memory layer
deployment_options: Managed cloud (app.mem0.ai), self-hosted OSS (github.com/mem0ai/mem0), Docker; 20+ vector store backends
pricing_summary: Free tier on platform; usage-based SM/API pricing for managed; OSS free self-host
integration_model: Python/TS SDK Memory and MemoryClient; explicit add/search API; 21 framework integrations (LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen, LlamaIndex, etc.) — no universal LLM interceptor
storage_backends: Vector stores (Qdrant, Pinecone, Chroma, pgvector, etc.); optional graph memory (Mem0^g) with Neo4j; conversation history in configured store
memory_tiers: User memory, session memory, agent memory, conversation memory — distinct scopes with different retention patterns per 2026 blog
graph_model: Mem0^g: directed labeled graph, entities as nodes, relationships as edges; LLM entity/relationship extraction; conflict resolution marks edges invalid not deleted
multi_tenant_model: user_id, agent_id, run_id, metadata filters on all operations
extraction_approach: LLM extraction with conversation summary S + recent m=10 messages + new message pair; 2026 algorithm: single-pass ADD-only hierarchical extraction
update_operations: Classic: LLM tool-call ADD, UPDATE, DELETE, NOOP vs top-s similar memories; 2026 variant emphasizes ADD-only to avoid information loss
consolidation_strategy: Async summary refresh; update phase maintains KB coherence; importance via access and semantic dedup
temporal_model: Timestamps on memories; strong temporal query gains (+29.6 LoCoMo points in 2026 algo); open problem: temporal abstraction at scale
agent_fact_handling: 2026: agent-generated facts stored with equal weight to user-stated facts
retrieval_signals: Multi-signal parallel: semantic embedding similarity + BM25 keyword + entity matching; fused ranking
reranking: Multi-signal fusion scoring; details in memory-benchmarks repo
latency_profile: Paper: 91% lower p95 vs full-context; 2026 ~6.9k tokens/query on LoCoMo/LongMemEval
token_efficiency: ~90%+ token savings vs full-context (~26k tokens/conversation baseline in 2025 paper)
multimodal_support: Limited in core OSS; platform features evolve — check docs for attachments
user_profiles: User-scoped memory collections; behavioral inference via stored facts
procedural_memory: Agent state and run-scoped memory supported via metadata
framework_integrations: 21 documented: LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen, LlamaIndex, OpenAI Agents SDK, etc.
locomo_scores: 2026 algorithm: 91.6 LLM-judge (blog); 2025 paper: 26% relative improvement vs OpenAI memory on LoCoMo
benchmark_methodology: Open-sourced github.com/mem0ai/memory-benchmarks; LoCoMo, LongMemEval, BEAM; BLEU, F1, LLM-judge, tokens, latency
stated_unsolved_problems: Cross-session identity resolution; temporal abstraction at scale; memory staleness management (State of AI Agent Memory 2026)
public_roadmap: Token-efficient algorithm; expanded integrations; benchmark transparency
known_limitations: Requires API integration; vector-store operational complexity; cost per LLM extract/update call
memorable_has: Cites Mem0 techniques; hybrid retrieval concept; consolidation inspired by Mem0
memorable_lacks: LLM extraction+update pipeline, conversation summary, multi-signal BM25+entity retrieval, published LoCoMo scores, 21 integrations, agent-fact parity
memorable_should_port: Extraction+update phases (arXiv:2504.19413); 2026 multi-signal retrieval fusion; ADD-only option; async summary; benchmark harness
memorable_should_skip: Managed-only platform features; forcing single vector-vendor lock-in
